1.web: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,
1.kjv: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
1.bsb: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,

1.web: who testified to God’s word, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.
1.kjv: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
1.bsb: who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

1.web: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is at hand.
1.kjv: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
1.bsb: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it, because the time is near.

1.web: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;
1.kjv: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
1.bsb: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from Him who is and was and is to come, and from the seven Spirits before His throne,

1.web: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood;
1.kjv: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
1.bsb: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood,

1.web: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father; to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
1.kjv: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
1.bsb: who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.

1.web: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.
1.kjv: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
1.bsb: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him—even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.

1.web: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
1.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
1.bsb: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty.

1.web: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
1.bsb: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.

1.web: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet
1.kjv: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
1.bsb: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,

1.web: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
1.kjv: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
1.bsb: saying, “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”

1.web: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.
1.kjv: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
1.bsb: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,

1.web: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.
1.kjv: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
1.bsb: and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around His chest.

1.web: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.
1.kjv: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
1.bsb: The hair of His head was white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes were like a blazing fire.

1.web: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.
1.kjv: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
1.bsb: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.

1.web: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
1.kjv: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
1.bsb: He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

1.web: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,
1.kjv: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
1.bsb: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,

1.web: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
1.kjv: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
1.bsb: the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.

1.web: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter;
1.kjv: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
1.bsb: Therefore write down the things you have seen, and the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.

1.web: the mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.
1.kjv: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
1.bsb: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

2.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:
2.kjv: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
2.bsb: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.

2.web: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.
2.kjv: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:
2.bsb: I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.

2.web: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.
2.kjv: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name’s sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
2.bsb: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.

2.web: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
2.kjv: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
2.bsb: But I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love.

2.web: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.
2.kjv: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
2.bsb: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.

2.web: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
2.kjv: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
2.bsb: But you have this to your credit: You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

2.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.
2.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
2.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.

2.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:
2.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
2.bsb: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.

2.web: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
2.kjv: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
2.bsb: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.

2.web: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
2.kjv: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
2.bsb: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Look, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.

2.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.
2.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
2.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.

2.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:
2.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;
2.bsb: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.

2.web: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
2.kjv: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan’s seat is : and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
2.bsb: I know where you live, where the throne of Satan sits. Yet you have held fast to My name and have not denied your faith in Me, even in the day when My faithful witness Antipas was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

2.web: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.
2.kjv: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
2.bsb: But I have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.

2.web: So you also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans likewise.
2.kjv: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
2.bsb: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

2.web: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.
2.kjv: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
2.bsb: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.

2.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no one knows but he who receives it.
2.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
2.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.

2.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:
2.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
2.bsb: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.

2.web: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.
2.kjv: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
2.bsb: I know your deeds—your love, your faith, your service, your perseverance—and your latter deeds are greater than your first.

2.web: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman, Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
2.kjv: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
2.bsb: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.

2.web: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.
2.kjv: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
2.bsb: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.

2.web: Behold, I will throw her into a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great oppression, unless they repent of her works.
2.kjv: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
2.bsb: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.

2.web: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.
2.kjv: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
2.bsb: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.

2.web: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira, as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan,’ to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.
2.kjv: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
2.bsb: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan: I will place no further burden upon you.

2.web: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.
2.kjv: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
2.bsb: Nevertheless, hold fast to what you have until I come.

2.web: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.
2.kjv: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
2.bsb: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.

2.web: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots; as I also have received of my Father:
2.kjv: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
2.bsb: He will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery—just as I have received authority from My Father.

2.web: and I will give him the morning star.
2.kjv: And I will give him the morning star.
2.bsb: And I will give him the morning star.

2.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
2.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
2.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

3.web: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
3.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
3.bsb: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.

3.web: Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.
3.kjv: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
3.bsb: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which was about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.

3.web: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.
3.kjv: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
3.bsb: Remember, then, what you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour when I will come upon you.

3.web: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
3.kjv: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
3.bsb: But you do have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white.

3.web: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
3.kjv: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
3.bsb: Like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and His angels.

3.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
3.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
3.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

3.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:
3.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
3.bsb: To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.

3.web: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.
3.kjv: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
3.bsb: I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. For you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.

3.web: Behold, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie. Behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
3.kjv: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
3.bsb: Look at those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead. I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.

3.web: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing, which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
3.kjv: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
3.bsb: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

3.web: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
3.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
3.bsb: I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.

3.web: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
3.kjv: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
3.bsb: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.

3.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
3.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
3.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

3.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:
3.kjv: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
3.bsb: To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation.

3.web: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
3.kjv: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
3.bsb: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were one or the other!

3.web: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
3.kjv: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
3.bsb: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!

3.web: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;
3.kjv: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
3.bsb: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.

3.web: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
3.kjv: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
3.bsb: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.

3.web: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
3.kjv: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
3.bsb: Those I love, I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.

3.web: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.
3.kjv: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
3.bsb: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.

3.web: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father on his throne.
3.kjv: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
3.bsb: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.

3.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
3.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
3.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”

4.web: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”
4.kjv: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
4.bsb: After this I looked and saw a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had previously heard speak to me like a trumpet was saying, “Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.”

4.web: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne
4.kjv: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
4.bsb: At once I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne standing in heaven, with someone seated on it.

4.web: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.
4.kjv: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
4.bsb: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.

4.web: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.
4.kjv: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
4.bsb: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads.

4.web: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
4.kjv: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
4.bsb: From the throne came flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder. Before the throne burned seven torches of fire. These are the seven Spirits of God.

4.web: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
4.kjv: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
4.bsb: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.

4.web: The first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
4.kjv: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
4.bsb: The first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.

4.web: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”
4.kjv: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him ; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
4.bsb: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”

4.web: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,
4.kjv: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,
4.bsb: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne who lives forever and ever,

4.web: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne, and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,
4.kjv: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
4.bsb: the twenty-four elders fall down before the One seated on the throne, and they worship Him who lives forever and ever. They cast their crowns before the throne, saying:

4.web: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed, and were created!”
4.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
4.bsb: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and came to be.”

5.web: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
5.kjv: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
5.bsb: Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the One seated on the throne. It had writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals.

5.web: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”
5.kjv: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
5.bsb: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”

5.web: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look in it.
5.kjv: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
5.bsb: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.

5.web: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look in it.
5.kjv: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
5.bsb: And I began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.

5.web: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome; he who opens the book and its seven seals.”
5.kjv: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
5.bsb: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.”

5.web: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.
5.kjv: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
5.bsb: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.

5.web: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
5.kjv: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
5.bsb: And He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.

5.web: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
5.kjv: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
5.bsb: When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

5.web: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book, and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood, out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
5.kjv: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
5.bsb: And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.

5.web: and made us kings and priests to our God, and we will reign on the earth.”
5.kjv: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
5.bsb: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign upon the earth.”

5.web: I saw, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands;
5.kjv: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
5.bsb: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels and living creatures and elders encircling the throne, and their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.

5.web: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
5.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
5.bsb: In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”

5.web: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”
5.kjv: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
5.bsb: And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”

5.web: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
5.kjv: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
5.bsb: And the four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.

6.web: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”
6.kjv: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
6.bsb: Then I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a thunderous voice, “Come!”

6.web: And behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.
6.kjv: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
6.bsb: So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.

6.web: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”
6.kjv: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
6.bsb: And when the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”

6.web: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.
6.kjv: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
6.bsb: Then another horse went forth. It was bright red, and its rider was granted permission to take away peace from the earth and to make men slay one another. And he was given a great sword.

6.web: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.
6.kjv: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
6.bsb: And when the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” Then I looked and saw a black horse, and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales.

6.web: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”
6.kjv: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
6.bsb: And I heard what sounded like a voice from among the four living creatures, saying, “A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine.”

6.web: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”
6.kjv: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
6.bsb: And when the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”

6.web: And behold, a pale horse, and he who sat on it, his name was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.
6.kjv: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
6.bsb: Then I looked and saw a pale green horse. Its rider’s name was Death, and Hades followed close behind. And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.

6.web: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.
6.kjv: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
6.bsb: And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.

6.web: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”
6.kjv: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
6.bsb: And they cried out in a loud voice, “How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You avenge our blood and judge those who dwell upon the earth?”

6.web: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.
6.kjv: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were , should be fulfilled.
6.bsb: Then each of them was given a white robe and told to rest a little while longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers, were killed, just as they had been killed.

6.web: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.
6.kjv: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
6.bsb: And when I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair, and the whole moon turned blood red,

6.web: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.
6.kjv: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
6.bsb: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth like unripe figs dropping from a tree shaken by a great wind.

6.web: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
6.kjv: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
6.bsb: The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.

6.web: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
6.kjv: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
6.bsb: Then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.

6.web: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,
6.kjv: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
6.bsb: And they said to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb.

6.web: for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?”
6.kjv: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
6.bsb: For the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?”

7.web: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.
7.kjv: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
7.bsb: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back its four winds so that no wind would blow on land or sea or on any tree.

7.web: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,
7.kjv: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
7.bsb: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, with the seal of the living God. And he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:

7.web: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”
7.kjv: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.
7.bsb: “Do not harm the land or sea or trees until we have sealed the foreheads of the servants of our God.”

7.web: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:
7.kjv: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
7.bsb: And I heard the number of those who were sealed, 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel:

7.web: of the tribe of Judah were sealed twelve thousand, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,
7.kjv: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
7.bsb: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben 12,000, from the tribe of Gad 12,000,

7.web: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,
7.kjv: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
7.bsb: from the tribe of Asher 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000,

7.web: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,
7.kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
7.bsb: from the tribe of Simeon 12,000, from the tribe of Levi 12,000, from the tribe of Issachar 12,000,

7.web: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
7.kjv: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
7.bsb: from the tribe of Zebulun 12,000, from the tribe of Joseph 12,000, and from the tribe of Benjamin 12,000.

7.web: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.
7.kjv: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
7.bsb: After this I looked and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.

7.web: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
7.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
7.bsb: And they cried out in a loud voice: “Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

7.web: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,
7.kjv: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
7.bsb: And all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. And they fell facedown before the throne and worshiped God,

7.web: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
7.kjv: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
7.bsb: saying, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

7.web: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and from where did they come?”
7.kjv: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
7.bsb: Then one of the elders addressed me: “These in white robes,” he asked, “who are they, and where have they come from?”

7.web: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes, and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.
7.kjv: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
7.bsb: “Sir,” I answered, “you know.” So he replied, “These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

7.web: Therefore they are before the throne of God, they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.
7.kjv: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.
7.bsb: For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.

7.web: They will never be hungry, neither thirsty any more; neither will the sun beat on them, nor any heat;
7.kjv: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
7.bsb: ‘Never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst; nor will the sun beat down upon them, nor any scorching heat.’

7.web: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them, and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”
7.kjv: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
7.bsb: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’”

8.web: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
8.kjv: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
8.bsb: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

8.web: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
8.kjv: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.
8.bsb: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.

8.web: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.
8.kjv: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
8.bsb: Then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.

8.web: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.
8.kjv: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel’s hand.
8.bsb: And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God from the hand of the angel.

8.web: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.
8.kjv: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
8.bsb: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder, and rumblings, and flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.

8.web: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
8.kjv: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
8.bsb: And the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.

8.web: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
8.kjv: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
8.bsb: Then the first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were hurled down upon the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass.

8.web: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,
8.kjv: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
8.bsb: Then the second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,

8.web: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.
8.kjv: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
8.bsb: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

8.web: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of the waters.
8.kjv: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;
8.bsb: Then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven and landed on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.

8.web: The name of the star is called “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.
8.kjv: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
8.bsb: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood oil, and many people died from the bitter waters.

8.web: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars; so that one third of them would be darkened, and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.
8.kjv: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
8.bsb: Then the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun and moon and stars were struck. A third of the stars were darkened, a third of the day was without light, and a third of the night as well.

8.web: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe for those who dwell on the earth, because of the other voices of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”
8.kjv: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
8.bsb: And as I observed, I heard an eagle flying overhead, calling in a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the remaining three angels!”

9.web: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.
9.kjv: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
9.bsb: Then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and it was given the key to the pit of the Abyss.

9.web: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.
9.kjv: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
9.bsb: The star opened the pit of the Abyss, and smoke rose out of it like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke from the pit.

9.web: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
9.kjv: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
9.bsb: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.

9.web: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.
9.kjv: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.
9.bsb: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

9.web: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion, when it strikes a person.
9.kjv: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
9.bsb: The locusts were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.

9.web: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
9.kjv: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
9.bsb: In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will escape them.

9.web: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.
9.kjv: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
9.bsb: And the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle, with something like crowns of gold on their heads, and faces like the faces of men.

9.web: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.
9.kjv: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
9.bsb: They had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions.

9.web: They had breastplates, like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots, or of many horses rushing to war.
9.kjv: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
9.bsb: They also had thoraxes like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.

9.web: They have tails like those of scorpions, and stings. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.
9.kjv: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
9.bsb: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.

9.web: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.
9.kjv: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
9.bsb: They were ruled by a king, the angel of the Abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon.

9.web: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.
9.kjv: One woe is past; and , behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
9.bsb: The first woe has passed. Behold, two woes are still to follow.

9.web: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,
9.kjv: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
9.bsb: Then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God

9.web: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”
9.kjv: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
9.bsb: saying to the sixth angel with the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”

9.web: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.
9.kjv: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
9.bsb: So the four angels who had been prepared for this hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.

9.web: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.
9.kjv: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
9.bsb: And the number of mounted troops was two hundred million; I heard their number.

9.web: Thus I saw the horses in the vision, and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.
9.kjv: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
9.bsb: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.

9.web: By these three plagues were one third of mankind killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.
9.kjv: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
9.bsb: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that proceeded from their mouths.

9.web: For the power of the horses is in their mouths, and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads, and with them they harm.
9.kjv: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
9.bsb: For the power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; indeed, their tails were like snakes, having heads with which to inflict harm.

9.web: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood; which can’t see, hear, or walk.
9.kjv: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
9.bsb: Now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands. They did not stop worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.

9.web: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.
9.kjv: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
9.bsb: Furthermore, they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.

10.web: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
10.kjv: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
10.bsb: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.

10.web: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.
10.kjv: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
10.bsb: He held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.

10.web: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
10.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
10.bsb: Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices.

10.web: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”
10.kjv: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
10.bsb: When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to put it in writing. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.”

10.web: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky,
10.kjv: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
10.bsb: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven.

10.web: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,
10.kjv: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
10.bsb: And he swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it: “There will be no more delay!

10.web: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants, the prophets.
10.kjv: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
10.bsb: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”

10.web: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”
10.kjv: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
10.bsb: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, “Go, take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.”

10.web: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it, and eat it up. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
10.kjv: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it , and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.
10.bsb: And I went to the angel and said, “Give me the small scroll.” “Take it and eat it,” he said. “It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
